To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the development of 3D cultural games for the purpose of education is a complex process, that involves a lot of work, that requires a lot of knowledge in many areas and that is not a one man job, but rather the result of a team effort, with the participation of many people, each one of them having a different role and a different expertise.
the development of a SG requires a multidisciplinary team of experts, a well defined game design, a game engine, 3D models of the real world, and an interactive environment.
3D models can be used to build new worlds of CH.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and development of a 3D game engine that will be used as an educational tool for the dissemination of CH.

the development and implementation of a 3D game engine for cultural heritage, the use of 3D assets for creating a virtual environment, the use of a game engine for the development of a game and the use of a 3d game as a serious game.
the use of 3D technology in the design of SGs for learning and communication in cultural heritage.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Digiart project has been successful in its objectives.
the use of SGs for learning is a promising approach in the context of CH, and the results of this work can be applied to a wide variety of CH applications.
the development of these SGs was a successful process that was achieved through the use of a variety of technologies, tools and techniques.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of 3D assets and the application of game engine for the development of SGs for CH is feasible, and the results are promising.
we have developed a pipeline that is able to generate accurate 3D content for a game engine and we have successfully applied it on three case studies.
SGs are the future of CH and they can be used to communicate and educate to the general public.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of SGs in CH is an effective way to engage and communicate with the public and to provide new ways to learn and experience the cultural heritage of Europe.
SGs are an ideal tool to engage the public in CH, especially for the young generations.
the use of 3D assets in the context of a SG is a promising approach to engage users in learning and communicating CH.
